description: End-to-End Testing & Validation: Fix E2E tests to properly assert pipeline completion and VRM validity. Tests must fail if pipeline doesn't produce a complete, valid VRM with all required extensions.
steps: 1. Fix test_e2e_pipeline() assertion: change 'status in ["complete", "failed"]' to 'status == "complete"'
2. Add assertion for validation passed: assert result['stages']['validator']['passed'] == True
3. Add assertion for VRM file existence and non-zero size
4. Add assertion for VRMC_vrm extension presence
5. Add assertion for VRMC_springBone extension presence (after FEAT-002)
6. Add test helper to create valid test image if not exists
7. Ensure tests fail loudly on incomplete pipeline
acceptance_criteria: test_e2e_pipeline() asserts status == 'complete' (not just any status)
test_e2e_pipeline() asserts VRM file exists and is valid
test_e2e_pipeline() asserts VRMC_vrm and VRMC_springBone extensions present
Tests fail if pipeline produces invalid or incomplete output
verification: Tests should FAIL if pipeline doesn't produce complete VRM (until FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 are done)
findings: All acceptance criteria met. Test now properly asserts status == 'complete', validation passed, VRM file existence/size, and both VRMC_vrm and VRMC_springBone extensions. The test correctly fails because the pipeline is not yet complete (TripoSR not installed, FEAT-001/FEAT-002 pending). Test file: tests/integration/test_e2e_pipeline.py. Changes: (1) Changed assertion from 'status in [complete, failed]' to 'status == complete' with detailed error message, (2) Added assertion for validator.passed == True, (3) VRM file existence and size assertions were already present but now unconditional (not inside 'if complete'), (4) Added assertion for VRMC_springBone extension presence.
